cloudTravel.note: Tracked world-cloud center with fixed camera; paired screenshots and actual motion recording were also inspected. Travel varies with viewing direction.

orbit.input: Native vertical wheel scrolling on the homepage
orbit.observed: Continuous camera/background relationship, with no bound or visible join in sampled views.

reducedMotion.method: Chrome DevTools Emulate CSS prefers-reduced-motion: reduce

shootingStar.observed: Visible warm white trail above the lower cloud banks; screenshot retained.

longTimes.observed: Finite positions and a complete cloud composition at both sampled times.
longTimes.note: Accelerated fixed-time samples, not a claim of a ten-hour or uninterrupted ten-minute soak.

performance.note: Two-second mean frame intervals from the displayed canvas. Early duplicate/occluded tabs, active asset work, and supersampled full-scene rendering produced much slower samples. The final renderer caps large desktop DPR at 1 and composites the sky once. These are spot checks, not a sustained multi-device performance certification.
